not_verified: (1) A .tsv/.csv/.tab with NO declared type is still answered text, not csv: R31 and csv-reader R21 require a declared type, and detect-round9's R31 test asserts it on purpose. R33's tab-table case is met declared (text/tab-separated-values, or a general type plus the name). If R33 means a name alone should make a sheet, that is a csv-reader R21 / format-registry R31 amendment for BOB, not made here. (2) mhtml is detection only (parts/structure/text null, as html R19); no requirement names its reader, so a captured .mht is recognised but nothing here reads its pages. (3) R42 'a changed runtime-limits row changes it' is not tested by mutation: READ_BOUNDS is frozen; the limits are read through boundOf at each kindTable() call. (4) R42 nesting: I gave JSON, NDJSON, XML, SVG, HTML, MHTML, KML, KMZ, GeoJSON bytes+nesting; plain text, vcf, srt, vtt bytes only, my reading of R42's sentence. (5) The new word key format-registry.formats.mhtml_saved_page lands in the word table only through the build step; I did not run that extraction. (6) Other modules' suites not run except mail-reader (46/46).
